title: Kept from the crease-ring experiment: pixel-sized surface dots for every marker, fixed-range field looks, and the groove-strength and bend-along-groove looks
user-messages:

yeah create a ticket for the stuff we are keeping and a separate worktree
description:
The parts of CRAW-102 (auto crease rings, being archived) the user chose to keep, ported uncommitted from the craw-102 worktree (tag archive/craw-102 once archived). The auto seeding, the V-key crease dots, Ctrl+U proposals, the crease path looks, the geodesic cache and the auto-rings / converge-rings routes are NOT carried over. The principal curvature fix is its own ticket (MESH-95).

Kept:
1. Surface dots: every surface marker (ring anchors, connection picks, diagnostic regions and markers, patch clouds, quad-layout corners, singularities, graph and embedded T-mesh nodes) is a screen-space disc a fixed number of pixels across, drawn through one MeshOverlayRuntime.setDots / clearDots / showDots layer API with a draw order (SurfaceDots, new). PointSet's world-space spheres, the sphere-radius caps, capDiagnosticRegion and focusOrbitOn's returned radius are gone. Files: MeshOverlayRuntime, QuadLayoutOverlay, PointSet (deleted), SurfaceDots, ConnectionTool, RingTool (anchor dots), EmbeddedTMeshScene, ModelScene.
2. Field looks over a fixed range: SurfaceLook fieldMin / fieldMax (NaN keeps the field's own range), ModelScene passes them to setPerVertexScalar, so a signed field puts zero mid-ramp.
3. Bend along the groove: SurfaceCreases.alongCurvature, the other principal curvature in the valley signal's sign, diffused like the valley signal (the diffusion loop becomes SurfaceCreases.diffuse); GrooveRingBenchmark follows the new constructor.
4. Two ring scene looks from CreaseOverlay (trimmed to them): creases (groove strength, the field crease rings follow) and crease-along (alongCurvature over -1..1: low convex, mid flat, high concave), both read from the ring tool's one crease lookup.
5. CrossFieldExaminationScene runs only scene_model then cross_field instead of the whole quad layout, so the layout's fold check no longer refuses a scan.
6. PatchColoursTest reads mesh.fs: it still points at mesh_scalar.fs, deleted by VIEW-31, so it fails on master.
7. scene_host.py also creates tmp/profiles on the remote host.
definition-of-done:
1. Builds from the worktree root with checkstyle clean; nothing from CRAW-102's archived parts remains (no CreaseValleySeeds, CreaseCandidates, ConvergingCreaseRings, SeedRing, CreaseLoopField, auto/converge routes, V dots, path looks, GROUPS colour, geodesic cache).
2. CreaseOverlayTest (the two looks read the ring tool's one crease lookup, no second build) and PatchColoursTest pass, and the full unit suite passes.
3. Screenshots in tmp/ on IMG_4113 in the ring scene: the creases look and the crease-along look; ring anchors as dots in the ring tool.
4. A screenshot of a quad-layout scene (embedded T-mesh or cross field examination) showing its nodes, corners or singularities as dots, and the cross field examination scene opening a scan without the fold refusal.
5. A launch entry opens IMG_4113 in the ring scene on the creases look.
testing-plan: 1. Build with checkstyle and the full unit suite from the worktree root. 2. Ring scene and quad-layout scene captures on the Mac scene host. 3. The user opens the launch entry and steps through the looks.
changes-made: Ported from the craw-102 worktree, uncommitted: SurfaceDots and the MeshOverlayRuntime dot-layer API (PointSet spheres and radius caps gone; quad-layout overlay, connection picks, ring anchors, embedded T-mesh scene moved over), fixed-range field looks (SurfaceLook fieldMin/fieldMax), SurfaceCreases.alongCurvature with the shared diffuse step, CreaseOverlay trimmed to the creases and crease-along looks (no V dots, path looks, proposals), CreaseOverlayTest covering both looks, CrossFieldExaminationScene on the cross field stage alone, PatchColoursTest on mesh.fs, scene_host tmp/profiles. Not carried: geodesic cache, GROUPS colour mode, refreshFieldLook, ui-state creaseOverlay, multiview --creases. Builds with checkstyle clean. Launch entry 'VIEW-32: IMG_4113 ring scene, M picks the creases and crease-along looks'.

Full unit suite 822/822 passes. IMG_4113 multiviews of the creases and crease-along looks in tmp/view-32-4113-creases.png and tmp/view-32-4113-crease-along.png. Not yet captured: ring anchor dots on a draft, a quad-layout scene's dots, the cross field examination scene on a scan.

Captures: tmp/view-32-4113-anchor-dots.png (ring draft's anchor dots on IMG_4113), tmp/view-32-tmesh-dots.png (embedded T-mesh nodes as dots, hidden by nearer surface), tmp/view-32-crossfield-botijo-singularities.png and tmp/view-32-crossfield-IMG_4109.png (cross field examination scene opening the repaired IMG_4109 scan, its field and singularity dots). The cross field scene is a plain ModelScene, so a scan opens as a repaired mesh file, not a .dsl (a .dsl path reports loaded but changes nothing, unchanged from master).

CreaseOverlay folded away: SurfaceCreases.strengthField() and alongBendField() give the two looks' values in the source mesh's active order, RingScene's looks read the ring tool's lookup through them; CreaseOverlayTest is now CreaseLooksTest.
review-summary: Surface markers become fixed-pixel SurfaceDots in named layers, the ring scene gains groove-strength and bend-along-groove looks, and the cross field examination scene runs only the cross field. These are the parts of the crease-ring experiment worth keeping: legible markers at any zoom, and scans no longer refused.
